reels.title: M02 BUZ KUBU
reels.caption:
Nothing is changing? Maybe you're at 31°. 🧊

Weeks of work and the ice doesn't move. Most people quit right here. But the work isn't lost. It's stored. At 32°, everything changes at once.

reels.title: M13 KOPRU
reels.caption:
You don't lose friends in a fight. You lose them to "next week." 🌉

One more deadline. One more late night. One more "sorry, I'm busy." Work will always want more hours. A friend only needs one.

Send this to the friend you keep telling "next week."

#friendship #worklifebalance #truefriends #lifelessons #selfgrowth
